items.headline: Nvidia shares fall after Jensen Huang’s abrupt departure; Colette Kress named interim CEO
items.summary: AP reported that Nvidia shares fell amid Huang’s resignation and that CFO Colette Kress became interim CEO. The report also noted that rival AMD and Broadcom shares moved higher while CoreWeave fell.

items.headline: Nvidia-led market volatility spreads across AI stocks
items.summary: AP reported that Nvidia initially plunged after Huang’s resignation, while Broadcom and AMD rose and CoreWeave and Micron declined. The moves indicated investor concern about Nvidia concentration alongside expectations that AI demand may broaden to other chip suppliers.

items.headline: Investor confidence in the AI trade is tested by Nvidia leadership turmoil and financing concerns
items.summary: Axios reported that Nvidia’s leadership crisis arrived during a broader period of concern about the AI build-out, including higher interest rates, data-center financing pressure and the company’s extensive financial links with AI firms and neoclouds.

items.headline: TSMC’s AI-driven stock surge fuels intense retail-investor participation in Taiwan
items.summary: Le Monde reported that TSMC’s shares have more than quadrupled in three years as AI demand strengthened the company’s strategic position, while widespread retail enthusiasm and borrowing to invest raised leverage and concentration concerns.
